Highly suggestive of **de Quervain’s tenosynovitis** (stenosing tenosynovitis of the first dorsal compartment), based on:  
- 3-month history of radial wrist/thumb pain exacerbated by functional loading (holding infant);  
- Positive Finkelstein’s test;  
- Absence of neurologic (no numbness/tingling in median nerve distribution) or inflammatory (no swelling/warmth/redness) features;
